title: PM-KUSUM Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan
summary: PM-KUSUM Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: Launched on 8th March 2019 by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy with the objective of
providing farmers with solar-powered irrigation pumps and promoting the use of barren land for solar
Component A: Installation of 10,000 MW decentralized solar plants on barren land.
Component B: Installation of 14 lakh solar-powered agriculture pumps.
Component C: Solarization of 35 lakh grid-connected agricultural pumps.
Generates additional income from solar power sales.
Promotes renewable energy and rural development.
Up to 60% subsidy (30% central, 30% state, 30% loan from banks).
Farmers contribute 10% of the total cost.
Farmers with agricultural land for solar pump installation.
